decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory tightly linked to core trailer sales and service, it still offers option value and little burden to keep in the catalogue.
This box trailer series sits in the firm's core market and capabilities, so if it remains after several years management would usually retain it unless a direct successor is ready.
The cover series complements trailer sales and aftermarket revenue, making it worthwhile to keep while it supports the broader transport solution offering.
With another box trailer series already established, the learning period is largely over and an overlapping line is the likeliest candidate for rationalization to free resources.
